commit_message: docs: record smart selection storage cleanup
patch:
@@ -50,2 +50,3 @@
   6. Smart Selection persistence only acknowledges the exact saved weight/query snapshot; changes made while a save is in flight are immediately reconciled and queued afterward, so an older async save cannot falsely mark newer refined weights durable
+  7. failed Smart Selection persistence removes a snapshot asset only when Core never accepted its revision-bound selection binding; once the binding is committed, the asset is retained even if a later project save fails, preventing both orphan storage leakage and broken committed references
